resolution.rationale: Binding clean re-audit. The official homepage and menu confirm the open Copperwood Tavern at 4021 Campbell Ave, Arlington, and the live menu hub exposes exactly eight current Owner-hosted PDFs: Lunch, Dinner, Brunch, Kids Brunch, Dessert, Drinks, Happy Hour, and Kids Lunch + Dinner. Those eight documents and the two complete online service-period surfaces reconcile to a 152-product union with no duplicate keys, undefined references, uncovered products, or partial surfaces. All 154 baseline rows are accounted for with coherent dispositions and mappings (123 exact, 21 normalized, 1 stale, and 9 artifact); the Brussels and Brussel Sprouts presentations collapse to one canonical product, while the two Short Rib records are legitimate starter and entree presentations. All four required matrix searches were repeated and support accurately_unavailable for a formal allergen matrix or cross-contact policy. The product layer nevertheless preserves restaurant-issued direct positive ingredient evidence on 85 products at restaurant_issued authority; the other 67 remain explicitly unavailable, every may-contain array is empty, and neither menu silence nor the best-attempt accommodation statement is converted into an allergen-negative or cross-contact guarantee.
